test_title: PYST 47: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

(O) as it was the last one of the evening

(P) the city bus was overcrowded

(Q) and this gave an opportunity

(R) to the pickpockets

(S) to try their skill
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (3)** i.e. **POQRS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with "**P** the city bus was overcrowded", which introduces the main subject.
 
• Following it, "**O** as it was the last one of the evening" provides the reason for the overcrowding.
 
• **Q** and this gave an opportunity" continues, indicating the consequence of the overcrowding situation.
 
• **R** to the pickpockets" specifies who benefited from the opportunity created.
 
• **S** to try their skill" completes the sentence by explaining what the pickpockets did with the opportunity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **POQRS.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (SRPOQ):** This option starts with "to try their skill to the pickpockets," which is an incomplete and incorrect beginning for the sentence.
 
• **Option 2 (PSORQ):** This option follows a similar structure, but it disrupts the logical flow by placing "and this gave an opportunity" before explaining the overcrowding.
 
• **Option 4 (SROPQ):** This option starts with "to try their skill to the pickpockets" and then explains the overcrowding, which creates an illogical and fragmented sentence structure.
